newsitem.title: USA: Linens 'n Things on track on superstores.
newsitem.headline: Linens 'n Things on track on superstores.

text.p: Linens 'n Things Inc said Wednesday it remained on track to open 20 to 25 superstores in 1997 to further expand its presence as a retailer of home furnishings.
The company defines superstores as those averaging approximately 35,000 square feet in size. Its traditional stores average 10,000 square feet.
The company said it closed five stores and opened one new one during the first quarter ended March 29.
The company, with 1996 sales of $696 million, operates 165 stores, including 132 superstores, across the U.S.
